up: Retrieve activity data for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1795186 (Bromodomain-containing protein 3). The target must have target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and tax_id = 9606 (Homo sapiens). Only include IC50 activity rows where standard_relation is '=' (exact values) and pchembl_value is not null. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (the chembl_id from the assay record), target type (target_type from the target dictionary), tax_id (from the target dictionary, should be 9606), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (the chembl_id from the molecule dictionary), standard type (should be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value (pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending and assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795186'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
